root: ^Silvana: Well met, traveler. Are you seeking simple arrows, or would you care to try one of our elven bows,
^ finely crafted in the old ways? Once you feel the smoothness of the string and hear the melody of its release, you will never return to ordinary wood.

c-2: ^Silvana: Indeed, and with great pride. Each morning I wander the misty woods in search of branches left by the night wind.
^ Sometimes, a tree offers me its own bough, as if granting a piece of its soul. These are the bows most cherished — born ready for their purpose.
^Silvana: I craft the string from the hair of meadow horses, leaving it under moonlight until it becomes as elastic as living silver.
^ Only then do I unite wood and string, and the bow gains its voice. Each piece is unique, each bow breathes its own spirit.

s0: ^Silvana: Every bow has its base strength. A magical bow can fire arrows of flame. The enemy feels both the weapon and the magic at once.
s1: ^Silvana: Never forget: the bow does not make the archer. Without skill, even the finest bow is a burden. And stiffness comes with a price — cramps, mistakes, and embarrassment.
s2: ^Silvana: Do I enjoy living here? As much as I can. One day I may close the shop and see the wider world. Perhaps when I have gathered enough gold. Would you like to help me along the way?
s3: ^Silvana: Many bring me flowers and compliments, but what I value most is someone who can appreciate a well-shaped piece of wood and a finely tuned string. That praise never fades.
